* Bestbuy BumRush Week: Jake and his friends have visited countless stores in order to acquire the allusive PS5... but it's always out of stock... and Jake is losing his mind.
* Ramses Week: BF brings GF along to catch up with his old upperclassmen friend Ramses from Highschool, but is a little surprised to learn how much has changed for him, but so little for Ramses.
AND NOW
* Ele.OS Demo!
&
* Bonus Ramses Song!
